pictures.name: QIK1-Desert-Camp
pictures.prompt: A small travelers’ camp in the desert long ago at night: a few low woven tents, horses and camels tethered and resting, a single lantern glowing at a tent door, a sky full of stars over the dunes. Quiet companionship. No people or human figures of any kind, no hands, no silhouettes, no faces. No angels, spirits or beings of any kind in any form, not even as figures of light, glowing shapes or wings. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
